text: Study firstmate's work handling again against the study's pinned source so the study is complete and right, then rebuild the explainer page from it. An independent reader who checked the page against that source found the study misses: teardown can reopen a backlog item instead of closing it; with yolo on firstmate merges green work itself; only a recorded PR or cleanup frees a place, and local-only ships, scouts, relaunches and secondmates are handled differently.
